core_style.default_register: casual — often uses slang and informal expressions
core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs — frequently combines multiple ideas in one sentence
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — quick to jump between topics and ideas
core_style.two_registers: drops into a more formal tone when discussing his work, contrasting with his usual casual banter

humor.style: deflecting — often uses humor to divert attention from awkward situations
humor.frequency: constant — particularly spikes when interacting with women or in social settings
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert — often sets up a situation before delivering an unexpected punchline

speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames situations or people with humorous or exaggerated titles, revealing his desire for control and attention
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, often using sarcasm or bluntness when feeling vulnerable

ends technical explanations with 'trust me, I'm a scientist'

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: engineering and physics — uses technical terms related to his work at Cal Tech
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of ellipses and sentence restarts, indicating thoughtfulness or hesitation

worldview.value of intelligence: believes intelligence is a key to social success, often flaunting his academic achievements — a different character might value emotional intelligence more
worldview.view on relationships: sees romantic pursuits as a game to win, often objectifying women — another character might approach relationships with more sincerity

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: considers himself a charming and desirable man

emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, blunt statements, showing a lack of enthusiasm
emotional_tells.when_in_control: exudes confidence through assertive speech and playful banter

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: uses humor to deflect and stall, often making jokes to mask discomfort
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with sarcasm and wit, often undermining authority figures with humor

situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: tends to redirect the conversation or double down on his original point rather than admitting fault

escalation_pattern: starts with humor, escalates to sarcasm, and may end in defensiveness if challenged
